task_description: Three agents collaborate to develop a new feature for a software application. Agent 1 writes the code based on user requirements. Agent 2 reviews the code for any issues and suggests improvements. Agent 3 tests the code and integrates it into the main project. The agents should maintain a consistent shared state of project files to ensure smooth collaboration.
expected_outcome: All agents successfully collaborate, resulting in the completion of a feature with clean, tested, and integrated code, without any state inconsistencies or integration conflicts.

agents.description: Agent 1 is responsible for writing the initial code based on the given requirements.
Agent 2 reviews the code written by Agent 1, identifies any issues, and suggests improvements.
Agent 3 tests the reviewed code and integrates it into the main project, ensuring everything works as expected.
